summaries.zh: Qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm 是基于 Claude 的技能，利用 MCP（模型上下文协议）实现多源内容（微信公众号、网页、YouTube、PDF、Markdown、搜索查询等）的自动化提取与结构化转换。它可将材料一键转化为 NotebookLM 支持的播客、PPT、思维导图和测验等格式。部署为 Claude 技能后，用户只需提供链接或文件，即可快速生成学习辅助材料或摘要，极大提升信息整理与再创作效率，适合研究者、教育者和内容创作者使用。
summaries.en: Qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm is a Claude skill that transforms diverse content sources—WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDFs, Markdown, and search queries—into NotebookLM-friendly formats like podcasts, PPTs, mind maps, and quizzes. Its key technical insight is using Claude's MCP (Model Context Protocol) to automate multi-source content extraction and structured conversion. You can deploy it as a Claude skill to instantly repurpose any online or offline material for learning, presentation, or review, making it ideal for researchers, educators, and content creators who want to quickly generate study aids or summaries from varied inputs.
